reader.requirement: In contained program B a reference to a condition-name, data-name, file-name, record-name or report-name is resolved over the set of all names B declares plus every GLOBAL name of A and of each program containing A, with qualification applied over that whole set until one or more objects is identified.

edition-consulted.switches: hands session.Edition to the unit's DataBinder (EditionContext): diagnostics wording and edition-gated clause checks; the inheritance seed (InheritStep.Seed) and InheritContainerGlobalData take no edition
below 2002 a data-description clause operand (ODO, KEY, RENAMES) takes no implicit qualifiers; not on the procedure-division reference path these rules govern

reader.edition-search: grep -n 'Edition|CobolVersion|Cobol1985|Cobol85|IsAtLeast|DialectBehavior' over InheritStep.cs, SymbolTable/SymbolTable.cs, SymbolTable.Reports.cs, SymbolTable.DataNameCandidates.cs, SymbolTable.Declarations.cs, SymbolTable.Files.cs, SymbolTable.IndexNames.cs, SymbolTable.ConditionNames.cs, ReportScope.cs and DataBinder.cs: TryResolve, TryResolveUnqualified, NearestDeclaring, NearestDeclaringData, NearestDeclaringConditions, NearerConditionNameHides, InheritGlobalSubtree and InheritReport consult no edition; the only hits are message citations (Edition.Edition.Cite), SumCounterOperand85 and ClauseOperandsTakeImplicitQualifiers
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the inheritance and the nearest-declaring narrowing are one path at every edition; only message citations differ
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb1047 covers data-names, condition-names and index-names; not file-names, record-names, report-names, or a container's GLOBAL report's sum counter whose spelling B also declares

probes.printed: I X=MID / I Y=INY / I YG=OUY / I XG=OUX / I Z=OUZ / I C=FALSE / I CCV=TRUE / J X=MID Z=OUZ / J C=FALSE / 3 X=OUX / 3 C=TRUE / O REC=IREC1 / O Y=NEW N=4 V=4AB**

probes.printed: COBOL1639 at 12 'IG' not defined (outer naming a contained program's GLOBAL item); 22 'NG' not defined (non-global item of the container); 23 'X' does not uniquely identify (two GLOBAL X in the container); 30 'IG' not defined (sibling's GLOBAL item)

OK  §1985:X.4.6.4 GR1  (python scripts/spec/cite.py --check "§1985:X.4.6.4 GR1" "All data-names subordinate to a global name are global names")

reader.notes: Data, condition, file, record and report names behave as the rule says (scope1, scoperef, scope2c). One name class is left out of the set: SymbolTable.InheritReport skips a container GLOBAL report's sum counter whenever B's own _dataNames holds the spelling (`if (family.Name is not { } sn || _dataNames.ContainsKey(Key(sn))) continue;`), deciding the hiding at inheritance by spelling alone, before qualification. So TOT OF CFG, which only the inherited sum counter satisfies, finds no counter and ReportEntryReferenceRefused refuses it, at --std 85 with a §2023:13.8.6.2.3 citation that 1985 does not have and that itself admits sum counters in the procedure division. A middle container's GLOBAL TOT does not trigger it (scope3).
